items.difficulty_reason: The lemma demands a whole commutative diagram of pointed schemes at once: affine elementary etale neighbourhoods (S', s') -> (S, s) and (X', x') -> (X, x), a closed immersion i : Z' -> X' of finite presentation with i_*G = g*F, a finite pi : Z' -> Y' with pi^{-1}({y'}) = {z'}, pure transcendence of kappa(y')/kappa(s'), and h : Y' -> S' smooth of relative dimension n = dim_x Supp(F_s) with geometrically integral fibres (statement lines 500-524). The proof splits on whether X_s equals Supp(F_s); the second case is the part that cannot be done routinely, because the closed subscheme Z' coming from the support of F_s must be embedded into a scheme etale over X x_S S' by applying the etale lifting lemma to Z' -> Z x_S S' -> X x_S S' while keeping X' affine (proof lines 566-584). The chapter's own lead-in at lines 441-443 advertises this very lemma as the key technical lemma that makes many later arguments of the chapter work, and later lemmas of the chapter (one step devissage, complete devissage) consume it as their engine.
